title: Hyundai Motor Brasil

sections.name: Hero Carousel
sections.description: Full-width rotating banner with 6 slides. Mix of promotional images and video backgrounds. Slides: 1) Promoção Copa banner image, 2) Video lineup 'quem testa', 3) Creta N Line promo image, 4) Hyundai Assina video, 5) Palisade video with title/CTA, 6) IONIQ 5 promo image.
sections.styling: Dark background, full-width, auto-rotating with pagination dots and arrows

contentSequences.content: Promotional banner image linking to promocao.hyundai.com.br
Creta N Line promotional image linking to /ofertas.html
Hyundai Assina video slide linking to /hyundai-assina.html
Palisade video with heading 'Hyundai PALISADE', subtext 'A primeira classe dos SUVs', CTA 'Saiba mais'
IONIQ 5 promotional image with offer details

sections.name: Kona Hybrid Video Hero
sections.description: Full-width video background section with Kona Hybrid car image overlay and CTA button 'Conheça' linking to /veiculos/kona-hibrido.html
sections.styling: Video background, car cutout overlay, dark theme

contentSequences.content: Kona Hybrid promotion with video background and car image overlay

sections.name: Vehicle Showroom
sections.description: Interactive vehicle browser with h1 'Confira os carros da Hyundai'. Category tabs (SUV(6), Hatchback(1), Sedan(1), Utilitário(1)). Shows vehicle with model, version, engine, transmission, color swatches, price, and CTA buttons. Currently displaying KONA Híbrido ULTIMATE 2025/2026. Vehicle slider with 9 models: KONA Híbrido, Novo CRETA, CRETA N Line, Tucson, PALISADE, IONIQ 5, HB20, HB20S, HR.
sections.styling: Dark background (#000), white text, vehicle image carousel

contentSequences.content: KONA Híbrido ULTIMATE 2025/2026 - Motor Kappa 1.6 GDI HEV - DCT - A partir de R$ 215.590,00

sections.name: Mosaic Grid
sections.description: Image mosaic grid with 5 items: top row has 2 side-by-side promotional cards (Creta offer, Kona offer), then 3 items below (IONIQ 5, Novo CRETA, Hyundai Now). All are linked images.
sections.styling: Grid layout, no text overlays - images contain text

sections.name: Offers Slider
sections.description: Offers section with h2 'Ofertas', subtitle 'Garanta já seu novo Hyundai 0 km.' Contains offer cards in slider format. Each card has vehicle image, model name, version, price, highlights, action icons (Falar consultor, Cotação, Reservar, Test Drive, Bluelink), and expandable specs list. Multiple vehicles shown.
sections.styling: Light background, card-based slider with dark offer cards

contentSequences.content: Ofertas - Garanta já seu novo Hyundai 0 km.
Multiple vehicle offer cards with pricing and CTAs

sections.name: Call to Action - Offers
sections.description: CTA section with image icon and text: 'A condição que você esperava para garantir o seu Hyundai 0km.' subtitle 'Conheça nossa página de ofertas.' CTA button 'Clique e confira' linking to /ofertas.html
sections.styling: Clean layout with icon + text + button

sections.name: Services Link Hub
sections.description: Services hub section with h2 'Proprietários', icon + h3 'Serviços'. Contains service links: Recall, Revisão programada, Garantia, Manuais, Bluelink, Agendamento de serviços. Also has a large scheduling services banner image with CTA.
sections.styling: White background, link list with banner image

notes: This is a React SPA homepage with complex interactive components. The vehicle showroom has interactive category filtering, color swatches, and vehicle slider - these need simplification for EDS authoring. The offers section contains extensive vehicle specification lists that should be condensed for the homepage migration.
